verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ arakkhitaṁ mahato anatthāya saṁvattati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, cittaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that, when it’s not protected, is so very harmful as the mind.

verses.pali: Cittaṁ, bhikkhave, arakkhitaṁ mahato anatthāya saṁvattatī”ti.
verses.english: An unprotected mind is very harmful.”
